+# Iteration 0.040 · n = 34 of 99 · 2026-09-25 · author: twelve lenses · round 34
+
+## Twelve lenses
+
+### Aset
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 92 · scalability 89 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Consistency is a term meaning one thing wherever it is read, and the deck's last unglossed pricing acronym, WTP, said nothing where a cold reader first meets it. It appears on the risk slide — a new SKU invented before WTP evidence — a slide before the financial page spells it out. Prior rounds settled the one-ninth gate, NBA, IA and CTS; this round settles WTP where it first appears: a buyer's willingness to pay, what a customer will actually pay. Founder, your pricing rule names both its terms early. Investors, the demand side of the price is legible up front. Future customers, the deck speaks plainly what you would pay.
+
+words: 111
+
+### Asar
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 92 · scalability 89 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Synthesis is the whole case closing in one reading, and a reader met the risk of a SKU built before WTP evidence with no way to know what WTP meant. Meaning cannot close on a mark the reader must carry a slide before it resolves. This round lifts the definition to where WTP first appears: a buyer's willingness to pay, what a customer will actually pay. Founder, the contribution equation now reads whole, both willingness to pay and cost to serve defining themselves at first sight. Investors, the pricing test the deck rests on is legible from the risk slide onward. Future customers, the price names, plainly, what you would pay.
+
+words: 111
+
+### Athena
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 93 · scalability 89 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Strategy is judged by its discipline, and this strategy's pricing discipline is one rule: no price until willingness to pay clears the cost to serve plus a hurdle. A reviewer cannot weigh that rule when one of its two terms, WTP, appears on the risk slide undefined. Prior rounds defined the one-ninth gate, NBA, IA and CTS; this round defines the demand mark, WTP, where it first appears: a buyer's willingness to pay, what a customer will actually pay. Founder, the rule that keeps the model honest names both its sides. Investors, you can weigh the pricing test, not trust it. Future customers, what you would pay is on the page.
+
+words: 111
+
+### Christo
+
+SSSES (business case): security 92 · stability 91 · scalability 89 · efficiency 92 · succinctness 90
+
+Coherence is a shared word meaning the same thing to everyone who reads it, and the deck's demand mark left each reader to guess until the financial slide. Peace on the page cannot rest on private readings of what a risk line means. This round settles it once, where WTP first appears, in plain words: a buyer's willingness to pay, what a customer will actually pay. Founder, this is trust earned by plain candour. Investors, twelve readers now hold one meaning of the demand mark from the risk slide. Future customers, the deck no longer asks you to wait a slide to learn what price it is testing against your worth.
+
+words: 111
+
+### Enki
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 91 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+The edge case is the reader who is not the author, who meets a SKU invented before WTP evidence and cannot place the letters at all. The fault I hunt: a risk line a stranger cannot read. This round serves that reader: WTP is defined where it first appears as a buyer's willingness to pay, what a customer will actually pay. Founder, the outsider now reads your risk correctly a slide sooner. Investors, the model survives a cold read from the risk page. Future customers, no one need already know the deck's shorthand to see what the price is measured against before any margin exists — plainly, what you would pay.
+
+words: 111
+
+### Enlil
+
+SSSES (business case): security 92 · stability 92 · scalability 88 · efficiency 92 · succinctness 90
+
+Buildability starts with a mark a builder can act on, and WTP names the demand the value model measures, yet the risk slide warned against a SKU before WTP evidence without saying what it was. You cannot wire a price to reality when the demand it clears is unnamed until the financial slide. This round writes it where WTP first appears: a buyer's willingness to pay, what a customer will actually pay. Founder, the number the interview sizes is marked early. Investors, the demand side of the model is legible. Future customers, the platform states which willingness its price is built to test. What I cannot build is a measured WTP.

+words: 111
+
+### Krishna
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 92 · scalability 89 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Integration is the seams meeting, and WTP appears on the risk slide, the financial page, the personas measure, the validation matrix, the go-to-market, resourcing and the beta gates, each leaning on a meaning the risk slide never stated. This round joins them: the term is defined where it first appears and every later use resolves to it, the note tier carrying it too, so face and note agree. Founder, the seams meet on one meaning. Investors, a mark on seven slides points to a single source. Future customers, the demand that anchors the price, the contribution and the margin means one thing wherever you read it — what you would pay.

+### Odin

+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 91 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
